history.notes: A more compact About tab with the version history, and How it works and Your changes folded away. Updates are now checked each time Firefox starts; turn off Check at startup to check only by hand.

Each space, private ones included, can have its own download folder (right-click a space → Download Folder): its downloads and Save As go there, and the Library's Open downloads folder opens it. First start now also asks for the needed restart in a notification bar.
First versioned release: an About tab in the Library, with daily update checks and in-place updates that keep your edits.
